content: The Savāniḥ al-Ayyām of Ṣunʿ Allāh Niʿmatullāhī survives only in excerpts inside Mufīd Mustawfī's Jāmiʿ-i Mufīdī (fl. 1091/1680), who amplified it from Shūshtarī's Majālis al-Muʾminīn; MK notes that it is concerned to establish Niʿmat Allāh's Shiʿi leanings, which may suggest an early Safavid provenance, and that Aubin conjectures it is contemporary with Kirmānī's Tazkira.
refers_to_primary: Ṣunʿ Allāh Niʿmatullāhī, Savāniḥ al-Ayyām fī Mushāhadat al-Aʿvām (via Mufīd Mustawfī, Jāmiʿ-i Mufīdī)
